name: USGS The National Map Transportation Trails
licenseOrTerms: USGS public data; review The National Map terms and metadata before production/commercial scaling.
attributionRequirement: Attribute USGS The National Map transportation data.
updateFrequency: USGS published service updates; verify publish/source edit dates per feature.
notes: Layer 37 was verified as the broad Trails layer for San Juan / Southwest Colorado. Layer 11 is National Trails only and too narrow for v1.

name: USDA Forest Service Enterprise Data Warehouse Trails
licenseOrTerms: Public federal data; respect USDA/ArcGIS service terms and not-for-navigation caveats.
attributionRequirement: Attribute USDA Forest Service EDW and the managing forest when known.
updateFrequency: Periodic EDW updates; verify service metadata.
notes: Already used at runtime; deferred from this file-based ingestion v1 unless explicitly added later.

name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass
licenseOrTerms: OpenStreetMap data is licensed under ODbL.
attributionRequirement: Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors; derived database obligations may apply.
notes: Use as open/community context and fallback. Do not overstate authority.

name: National Park Service API and Data
licenseOrTerms: NPS API key and terms apply.
attributionRequirement: Attribute National Park Service and preserve park/unit links.
updateFrequency: API dependent; alerts can change frequently.
notes: Planned source for park alerts, campgrounds, boundaries, permits, and closures.

name: Recreation.gov RIDB
licenseOrTerms: RIDB API key and Recreation.gov terms apply.
attributionRequirement: Preserve Recreation.gov facility URLs and last-updated values where available.
updateFrequency: API dependent; reservation and availability status can change frequently.
notes: Used for federal facilities and campsite/reservation enrichment, not trail geometry.

name: Bureau of Land Management Open Data
licenseOrTerms: Public federal datasets vary by layer; verify metadata before ingest.
attributionRequirement: Attribute BLM and preserve source layer URLs.
notes: Planned source for public land boundaries, recreation sites, roads, and dispersed recreation context.

name: State and Local Open GIS Portals
licenseOrTerms: Terms vary by portal and layer.
attributionRequirement: Attribute the state/local agency and preserve source URLs.
notes: Placeholder for legally usable state/local trail, campsite, trailhead, closure, and park data.

name: Colorado Trail Explorer
endpoint: Colorado Parks and Wildlife ArcGIS FeatureServer
licenseOrTerms: Confirm COTREX/state terms before production/commercial redistribution.
attributionRequirement: Attribute COTREX/Colorado Parks and Wildlife and preserve official trail URLs when present.
notes: Already used at runtime for Colorado trail enrichment; not part of this first file-based ingestion step.

name: USGS 3DEP Elevation
licenseOrTerms: USGS public data; verify service terms.
notes: Planned/active elevation source for gain/loss, slope, effort, and snow-risk proxies.

name: WFIGS / NIFC Wildfire Feeds
licenseOrTerms: Public interagency wildfire feeds; verify layer-specific terms.
attributionRequirement: Attribute WFIGS/NIFC and direct users to official closure information.
notes: Used for fire context. Does not prove trail closure status.

name: Open-Meteo
attributionRequirement: Attribute Open-Meteo when forecast data is shown.
notes: Weather context only; not trail geometry.
